tasks.short: Assess Noordhaven’s financial position and forecast cash, profit and funding needs across the three sites.

today.trigger: Monthly forecasting, a management question, or a material change in trading or cash.
steps: Pull actuals from the nightly AFAS extract and check the latest available period.
Collect volume, staffing and spending assumptions from the sites and FP&A.
Update Excel forecasts and reconcile them to the general ledger.
Investigate changes in margins, cash and working capital.
Explain the outlook and recommend action to management.
drudgery: Reconciling slightly different versions of actuals
Copying site assumptions into forecast workbooks
Rewriting explanations for recurring variances
today.time_sinks: Waiting for site assumptions and tracing differences between spreadsheets and the nightly extract.

lenses.faster: Reconciled actuals, calculated forecast movements and linked supporting records arrive together. Copying figures and assembling the first explanation disappear.
lenses.autonomous: Each successful nightly refresh updates approved forecast calculations and flags material changes. A new forecast remains a draft until its assumptions are approved.
lenses.ambitious: Maintain a rolling cash outlook and site-level downside scenarios between monthly closes. Test whether the forecast would have predicted previous cash and margin problems.
lenses.joy: Remove workbook repair and number chasing. Keep the conversations about what is changing in the business and which action matters.
lenses.options: Compare base, lower-volume, higher-agency-cost, slower-payment and combined-stress scenarios using the same reconciled starting point.
lenses.altitude: Design the forecasting rules, assumption ownership and quality checks. Review exceptions and forecast errors instead of rebuilding the analysis.
reach: FP&A Analyst: first-pass forecast consolidation and variance analysis
Controller: cross-site financial health checks
Credit and Collections Officer: working-capital trend analysis

tasks.human_edge: Judge whether site assumptions are credible, challenge optimistic forecasts and take responsibility for financing and operating recommendations.
tasks.pattern_why: agent_with_gate: a workflow gathers several sources, runs deterministic financial calculations and drafts explanations; the director approves assumptions and conclusions before the forecast counts.

in_practice.trigger: A validated nightly AFAS refresh or an approved change to a forecast assumption.
steps: Check extract freshness, ledger reconciliation and required source coverage.
Run versioned cash, profit and working-capital calculations using approved assumptions.
Identify material movements and draft explanations linked to supporting data.
Produce alternative scenarios and an exception list for FP&A and the director.
Publish the approved forecast version and record later actual-versus-forecast results.
in_practice.human_gate: FP&A validates the inputs; the Finance Director approves material assumptions, forecast release and recommended actions.
systems: AFAS Profit through an authorised extract
SharePoint for forecast versions and approvals
An approved language-model service for draft explanations
data_needed: Reconciled ledger actuals by site and period
Open receivables and payables with due dates
Cash balances and financing terms
Approved site volume and staffing assumptions
Applicable CAO rates and approved employer-cost assumptions
Forecast history and subsequent actuals
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted SharePoint forecast register containing source timestamps, assumption versions, calculation versions, exceptions and approvals.

evidence.claim: Power BI supports scheduled refresh and calculated financial measures, providing components for recurring financial analysis.
Grounded draft explanations can reduce preparation effort when financial calculations and reconciliation remain deterministic.
The proposed workflow could save 65% of director effort and make the task 2.5 times faster; this is an unmeasured pilot estimate.

risks: A nightly extract is mistaken for a live cash position.
Unsupported explanations make a forecast appear more reliable than its assumptions.
Different CAO provisions or agency charging terms are flattened into one labour-cost rate.
Detailed payroll or absence records are exposed unnecessarily; use aggregated costs and apply AVG/GDPR access controls.
research_questions: Can actuals, receivables, payables and cash be reconciled automatically at the required site and period level?
Which operational volume data are available, and who owns each forecast assumption?
Does a backtest improve forecast accuracy and reduce preparation time against the existing process?
Which decisions require fresher data than the nightly Power BI extract provides?

tasks.short: Assess and prepare company financing requests when Noordhaven needs a loan or renewed credit facility.

today.trigger: If applicable: a fleet or warehouse investment, a working-capital funding gap, or a financing renewal.
steps: Confirm the funding purpose, amount, timing and approval authority.
Collect accounts, forecasts, existing debt terms and supporting documents.
Compare proposed interest, fees, security and repayment conditions.
Test affordability and covenant headroom in Excel.
Recommend terms and prepare the application or internal approval pack.
systems: Rabobank for available banking records and financing correspondence
drudgery: Re-entering the same company figures into application packs
Finding the latest signed financing documents
Comparing differently formatted term sheets
today.time_sinks: Missing lender documents, inconsistent definitions of covenants and repeated requests for supporting figures. Daily loan processing is not established for this company.

lenses.faster: Extract proposed terms into a comparison sheet and populate the supporting pack from approved financial records. Manual transcription and repeated document searches disappear.
lenses.autonomous: A financing renewal date starts document collection and readiness checks. Receipt of a term sheet triggers extraction and affordability calculations.
lenses.ambitious: Keep a financing-readiness pack current and identify approaching covenant or maturity problems before a funding request becomes urgent.
lenses.joy: Remove repetitive form filling and clause hunting. Preserve negotiation and the judgement about how much financial flexibility Noordhaven needs.
lenses.options: Compare different loan sizes, maturities, fixed or floating rates, repayment schedules and downside trading assumptions.
lenses.altitude: Set borrowing limits, covenant definitions and approval rules. Review proposed financing against those rules rather than assembling each pack.
reach: Controller: debt schedule and covenant monitoring
FP&A Analyst: financing affordability scenarios
Accountant: supporting financial schedules for lenders

tasks.human_edge: Negotiate financing terms, judge acceptable security and restrictions, and hold responsibility for the borrowing recommendation.
tasks.pattern_why: agent_with_gate: document extraction and financial checks can prepare a financing pack, but ambiguous clauses, lender negotiation and borrowing commitments require human approval.

in_practice.trigger: An approved funding request, an approaching facility expiry, or a new lender term sheet.
steps: Create a financing case with the required amount, purpose and approval route.
Collect authorised financial records and identify missing lender requirements.
Extract terms with clause references and flag ambiguous definitions.
Calculate repayment capacity and covenant headroom under approved scenarios.
Present the comparison and application pack for approval before submission.
in_practice.human_gate: The director verifies material clauses and recommends the financing; authorised company signatories approve submission and any binding commitment.
systems: AFAS Profit through an authorised extract
An approved language-model service for term extraction
data_needed: Confirmed financing purpose and amount
Approved accounts and cash forecasts
Existing debt schedules and signed covenant definitions
Lender term sheets and application requirements
Company approval and signing authorities
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted SharePoint financing case with document versions, extracted clause references, calculation results and approval records.

evidence.claim: Excel supports repayment calculations and scenario comparisons for company financing.
Language models can extract candidate terms from financing documents, with human verification of material clauses.
Saving 55% of effort and doubling end-to-end speed is a proposed estimate, conditional on this task actually occurring at Noordhaven.

risks: This O*NET task may barely apply: Noordhaven is described as a logistics company, not a lender.
Incorrect extraction of security, guarantees or covenant definitions changes the financing assessment.
The workflow submits confidential documents or creates a binding commitment without the correct authority.
If scope expands to scoring natural persons’ creditworthiness, assess EU AI Act high-risk requirements; this proposed scope covers company financing.
research_questions: Does the director assess company borrowing requests, applications from other parties, or neither, and how often?
Which application steps consume director time rather than lender or accountant time?
Can extracted terms and covenant calculations match a manually verified sample without material errors?
Which submissions and commitments require board or other authorised-signatory approval?

tasks.short: Review overdue customer balances, collection progress and the cash at risk.

today.trigger: The regular collections review or a large customer balance becoming overdue.
steps: Read the AFAS receivables ageing and collections summary.
Check recent receipts, unmatched payments and credit notes.
Ask the Credit and Collections Officer about disputes and payment promises.
Identify material exposures and changes in expected collection dates.
Agree escalations and update the cash outlook.
drudgery: Rechecking whether payments have already arrived
Combining ageing reports with notes from emails
Reading unchanged balances at every review
today.time_sinks: Reconciling collection notes and receipts, and separating disputed invoices from ordinary late payments.

lenses.faster: Receive a reconciled list of changed and material balances with the latest collection status. Reviewing every unchanged account disappears.
lenses.autonomous: After validated receipt matching, refresh ageing, overdue exposure and broken payment promises. Route exceptions to the collections owner under approved rules.
lenses.ambitious: Review the whole receivables book daily and measure which collection actions improve payment timing.
lenses.joy: Remove repeated payment checks and report assembly. Keep problem solving with customers and decisions about significant exposures.
lenses.options: Compare the cash effect of resolving disputes, following up broken promises or escalating the largest overdue accounts first.
lenses.altitude: Define collection escalation rules, exposure limits and reporting quality. Review exceptions and the effectiveness of the collection process.
reach: Credit and Collections Officer: routine portfolio prioritisation
Bookkeeper: visibility of unmatched-receipt exceptions
FP&A Analyst: expected collection-date inputs to the cash forecast

tasks.human_edge: Balance cash protection against customer relationships, and decide on sensitive escalations, provisions or service restrictions.
tasks.pattern_why: deterministic_software: ageing, movement detection and threshold-based routing are checkable rules; optional llm_step extraction turns collection notes into statuses with links to the original evidence.

in_practice.trigger: A validated receivables refresh after bank receipts have been processed, or a recorded change in collection status.
steps: Reconcile open items, processed receipts, credit notes and reporting totals.
Calculate ageing and identify changed balances, disputes and overdue promises.
Attach source-linked collection notes and flag conflicting or missing statuses.
Publish the routine internal collections view and route threshold exceptions.
Record human decisions and feed approved expected receipts into the cash forecast.
in_practice.human_gate: Routine internal reporting runs without approval; people approve customer communications, credit holds, write-offs, provisions and changes to collection policy.
systems: Rabobank statement data after approved processing
data_needed: Open invoices, due dates and customer identifiers
Processed receipts, credit notes and unmatched-payment flags
Disputes, payment promises and responsible collection owners
Approved exposure and escalation thresholds
Historical invoice and payment dates
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted collections register recording source refreshes, reconciliation results, triggered rules, exceptions and human dispositions.

evidence.claim: Power BI can calculate and display receivables ageing and movements from structured financial data.
Rules can prioritise changed balances and broken payment promises without a language model making credit decisions.
A 75% director-effort saving and 3.5-times speedup are pilot estimates, not measured Noordhaven results.

risks: A payment received after the extract leads to an incorrect overdue status.
Incorrect receipt allocation hides or exaggerates customer exposure.
An extracted payment promise is treated as confirmed despite ambiguous wording.
Shared collection notes expose unnecessary personal information or sensitive customer details under AVG/GDPR.
research_questions: Are disputes and payment promises recorded consistently enough to support automatic exception detection?
How quickly do Rabobank receipts reach AFAS and the reporting extract?
What proportion of director review time concerns unchanged balances versus genuine exceptions?
Does a pilot preserve reconciliation accuracy while reducing review time and improving collection prioritisation?

tasks.short: Prepare and approve board reports and the financial filings Noordhaven is required to make.

today.trigger: A board reporting date, statutory filing deadline, audit request or other confirmed reporting obligation.
steps: Confirm the report requirements, deadline, reporting basis and responsible approver.
Collect reconciled ledger figures and supporting schedules.
Populate report templates and draft explanations.
Check consistency, required disclosures and supporting evidence.
Review with the controller or external adviser and approve the final version.
drudgery: Copying the same approved figures into several reports
Checking totals across tables and narrative
Finding evidence and chasing template versions
today.time_sinks: Late ledger adjustments, unclear reporting ownership and manual consistency checks across report versions.

lenses.faster: Populate approved templates from a frozen reporting dataset and run cross-document checks automatically. Re-keying figures and checking repeated totals disappear.
lenses.autonomous: The reporting calendar starts preparation and gathers required evidence. Missing schedules and failed checks create internal exceptions before the deadline.
lenses.ambitious: Make every material report figure traceable to its source and keep an evidence pack ready throughout the year.
lenses.joy: Remove formatting, version hunting and repetitive disclosure assembly. Keep the judgement about what the board and external readers need to understand.
lenses.options: Produce a concise board pack, a detailed supporting pack and alternative explanations of the same validated results.
lenses.altitude: Own the reporting calendar, accounting-policy choices and release controls. Review a complete draft with exceptions instead of assembling each document.
reach: Controller: first-pass reporting consolidation
Accountant: supporting schedules and evidence indexing
FP&A Analyst: consistent board commentary on actuals and outlook

tasks.human_edge: Approve accounting judgements, material disclosures and the final representation of the company’s financial position.
tasks.pattern_why: agent_with_gate: deterministic mappings and checks build the report, llm_step drafts source-linked commentary, and authorised people approve the reporting basis and final release.

in_practice.trigger: A confirmed reporting deadline and release of the approved reporting dataset.
steps: Select the applicable report template, obligation and approval route.
Populate tables from versioned ledger mappings and supporting schedules.
Run reconciliations, cross-footing and disclosure-completeness checks.
Draft narrative with references to validated figures and evidence.
Route the complete pack for review and archive the approved release.
in_practice.human_gate: The controller reviews reconciliation and accounting treatment; the director and other required signatories approve release or filing, with external advice where needed.
systems: AFAS Profit through an authorised extract
Power Automate for configured approval routing
An approved language-model service for commentary drafts
data_needed: Confirmed statutory, regulatory and board reporting requirements
Approved trial balance and reporting-period freeze
Account mappings and accounting policies
Supporting schedules and disclosure evidence
Controlled templates, prior approved reports and signing authorities
in_practice.logs_to: A SharePoint reporting register containing dataset versions, mapping versions, check results, evidence references and signed approval history.

evidence.claim: Power Automate supports approval workflows that can record decisions before document release.
Structured financial reports can be populated and checked using deterministic mappings, with language models drafting commentary from approved evidence.
Saving 60% of director effort and achieving a 2.2-times speedup require validation against Noordhaven’s actual reporting obligations.

risks: A generic template omits a requirement applicable to Noordhaven’s size, group structure or reporting basis.
A late adjustment leaves narrative and tables on different dataset versions.
Generated commentary adds unsupported assurances or omits material uncertainty.
Automated preparation is mistaken for authorised filing or professional accounting judgement.
research_questions: Which filings and board reports does the director actually own, and which remain with accountants or external advisers?
Can each required figure and disclosure be linked to a stable source and reviewed mapping?
How often do late adjustments invalidate a prepared report?
Does a parallel reporting cycle reduce preparation time without increasing audit adjustments or disclosure errors?

tasks.short: Improve finance systems, controls and procedures across purchasing, collections, closing and forecasting.

today.trigger: A recurring close delay, control failure, audit finding, user complaint or proposed systems change.
steps: Collect process metrics, audit findings and examples from the finance team.
Trace where transactions wait, require rework or bypass controls.
Review AFAS configuration, spreadsheet dependencies and approval practices.
Compare improvement options, costs and control effects.
Agree priorities, owners and implementation measures.
drudgery: Assembling evidence from separate logs and spreadsheets
Rewriting descriptions of the same process problems
Following up missing actions and ownership
today.time_sinks: Incomplete event data, unclear handoffs and separating configuration problems from process or training problems.

lenses.faster: Bring process metrics, control failures and representative examples into one briefing. Manual evidence assembly and first-draft recommendations shrink.
lenses.autonomous: Monitor agreed indicators such as close delays, invoice rework and overdue approvals. Repeated breaches create an evidence-backed improvement case for review.
lenses.ambitious: Run small improvement experiments with before-and-after measures across all four finance value streams.
lenses.joy: Reduce anecdote sorting and action chasing. Keep designing better ways of working with the people who use them.
lenses.options: Compare configuration changes, clearer ownership, training, deterministic automation and gated AI against the same problem and control requirements.
lenses.altitude: Manage a portfolio of measured finance improvements and set control standards. Stop treating every recurring issue as a separate firefight.
reach: Controller: control monitoring and improvement prioritisation
People Analytics and HRIS Analyst: finance-side requirements for AFAS integrations
HR Director: joint ownership of payroll-to-ledger and agency-cost handoffs

tasks.human_edge: Understand why people bypass a procedure, resolve competing priorities and judge whether a proposed saving weakens financial control.
tasks.pattern_why: copilot: software can assemble evidence and compare proposals, but choosing changes requires organisational judgement, control ownership and agreement with affected teams.

in_practice.trigger: An agreed performance threshold is breached or a person raises a documented process problem.
steps: Gather approved process events, control findings and representative transaction examples.
Calculate waiting, rework and exception rates without inventing missing events.
Prepare a source-linked diagnosis and several improvement options.
Review options with process owners and select a bounded pilot.
Measure the pilot against speed, error and control criteria before wider adoption.
in_practice.human_gate: The director and process owner approve the diagnosis, pilot and changes; IT and control owners approve access or configuration changes, with OR involvement where required.
systems: AFAS Profit reports and available authorised event data
An approved language-model service for evidence summaries
data_needed: Available transaction timestamps and workflow states
Close milestones and reconciliation failures
Audit findings and documented control requirements
Process-owner interviews and transaction examples
Configuration constraints, costs and access permissions
in_practice.logs_to: A SharePoint improvement register containing evidence, competing options, approved pilot scope, owners and before-and-after results.

evidence.claim: Power BI can monitor process indicators from available structured event and transaction data.
A copilot can prepare evidence summaries and options, while people validate causality and approve organisational changes.
The proposed 35% effort saving and 1.5-times speedup have not been measured at Noordhaven.

risks: Incomplete logs support a convincing but wrong explanation of the bottleneck.
A faster process weakens segregation of duties or approval controls.
Individual staff monitoring creates AVG/GDPR concerns and may require OR consent; start with process-level measures.
A recommendation assumes AFAS or agency-portal features that are unavailable under current configuration or contracts.
research_questions: Which systems expose reliable workflow timestamps and exception reasons?
What explains the largest close delay or invoice rework category when transaction samples are checked?
Can a bounded pilot improve the North Star without increasing errors or control overrides?
Which proposed changes require IT work, agency agreement or works council involvement?

tasks.short: Report site performance and financial risks so management can act before problems grow.

today.trigger: A management reporting cycle or a material operational or financial risk.
steps: Collect site results, staffing costs and available operational measures.
Reconcile finance totals and identify missing or stale inputs.
Calculate margins, cost movements and relevant risk indicators.
Ask site managers to explain unusual movements.
Prepare a management pack with actions and named owners.
drudgery: Combining three site packs
Repeating unchanged risk descriptions
Formatting charts and following up missing commentary
today.time_sinks: Missing operational denominators, inconsistent agency data and waiting for explanations from site managers.

lenses.faster: Generate site comparisons, changed risk indicators and a draft action pack from reconciled sources. Repeated chart production and pack consolidation disappear.
lenses.autonomous: A validated refresh recalculates approved indicators and flags threshold breaches. Missing operational inputs remain visible rather than becoming assumed values.
lenses.ambitious: Give each site an early-warning view of labour-cost pressure, customer concentration, cash exposure and operational cost trends.
lenses.joy: Remove repetitive pack production. Keep discussing which risks need intervention and whether the proposed action will work on a shift.
lenses.options: Compare actions such as changing agency mix, adjusting capacity or resolving billing disputes, with explicit financial assumptions.
lenses.altitude: Set risk definitions, thresholds and ownership. Review changing exposures and action effectiveness instead of producing recurring reports.
reach: Controller: cross-site risk and control reporting
FP&A Analyst: site performance briefings
HR Business Partner: aggregated staffing-cost and capacity analysis

tasks.human_edge: Interpret operational context, distinguish a temporary shift issue from a structural problem and assign credible action owners.
tasks.pattern_why: agent_with_gate: deterministic indicators and source-linked draft summaries prepare the pack, while site explanations and management actions require validation and approval.

in_practice.trigger: A validated reporting refresh or a material breach of an approved risk threshold.
steps: Check freshness, completeness and reconciliation of finance and operational inputs.
Calculate approved site indicators and compare them with targets and prior periods.
Draft explanations using documented site comments and linked evidence.
Prepare changed risks, scenario impacts and proposed action owners.
Obtain review and publish the approved management pack with action tracking.
in_practice.human_gate: Site owners validate operational explanations; the director approves material risk assessments and the management report.
systems: AFAS Profit through an authorised extract
An approved language-model service for report drafts
data_needed: Site-level revenue, costs and approved targets
Aggregated staffing hours, agency costs and applicable charging terms
Operational volumes and service measures from a confirmed source
Customer concentration and working-capital exposures
Approved risk thresholds, site explanations and action ownership
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted SharePoint risk and action register linked to report versions, source timestamps, threshold breaches and approvals.

evidence.claim: Power BI supports recurring dashboards and rule-based data alerts for supported dashboard tiles.
Combining deterministic indicators with reviewed, source-linked commentary is a plausible management-reporting workflow.
The 65% effort saving and 2.5-times speedup are estimates requiring a pilot with complete operational inputs.

risks: Financial data alone cannot establish warehouse productivity or service performance.
A threshold breach is presented as proof of a cause that has not been checked.
Site comparisons ignore different customer mixes, shift patterns or CAO provisions.
Aggregated workforce reporting drifts into individual performance scoring, raising AVG/GDPR, OR and potentially EU AI Act requirements.
research_questions: Where are reliable warehouse and transport volume measures held, and can they be joined to site costs?
Which indicators have previously predicted a material problem early enough to act?
Can agency hours and costs be reconciled consistently across all three portals?
Do site managers find the generated exceptions accurate and actionable during a parallel reporting pilot?

tasks.short: Use site costs, staffing plans and expected volumes to set credible budgets.

today.trigger: The annual budget cycle, a reforecast or a proposed change in site capacity.
steps: Collect historical costs, commitments and staffing assumptions.
Separate recurring costs, one-off items and volume-driven spending.
Apply agreed CAO, agency-rate and other cost assumptions.
Build and compare site budgets in Excel.
Challenge proposals with site managers and approve the consolidated budget.
drudgery: Mapping actual costs into budget lines
Updating repeated rate and volume formulas
Consolidating and checking site workbook versions
today.time_sinks: Unclear cost drivers, changing labour assumptions and repeated negotiation over site submissions.

lenses.faster: Build a reconciled cost baseline and calculate driver-based budgets with approved rate tables. Workbook consolidation and repeated formula edits disappear.
lenses.autonomous: An approved change to volume, staffing or rates recalculates draft budgets and flags material movements. Budget approval stays with the responsible people.
lenses.ambitious: Budget costs by their actual drivers and test unit-cost assumptions against subsequent results throughout the year.
lenses.joy: Remove spreadsheet maintenance and rate chasing. Keep the discussion about capacity, service commitments and realistic cost trade-offs.
lenses.options: Compare staffing mixes, overtime, agency dependency, volume growth and lower-demand scenarios, respecting CAO and operational constraints.
lenses.altitude: Own the cost-driver model and assumption governance. Challenge exceptions and resource choices rather than building budget arithmetic.
reach: FP&A Analyst: baseline construction and budget consolidation
Compensation and Benefits Specialist: financial modelling of approved labour-cost assumptions
HR Business Partner: cost scenarios for agreed workforce plans

tasks.human_edge: Judge achievable productivity, challenge hidden commitments and negotiate budgets that site managers can deliver.
tasks.pattern_why: agent_with_gate: deterministic software calculates costs from approved drivers, while the workflow gathers proposals and drafts comparisons for human approval of assumptions and budgets.

in_practice.trigger: The budget calendar opens or an authorised budget driver changes.
steps: Reconcile the cost baseline and flag unusual or unmapped items.
Load versioned volume, staffing, CAO and agency-rate assumptions.
Calculate site budgets and scenarios using documented cost-driver formulas.
Draft explanations of changes and identify assumptions needing challenge.
Route proposals for site and director approval, then freeze the approved version.
in_practice.human_gate: HR or payroll validates applicable labour assumptions, sites validate capacity plans, and the director approves the financial budget through company governance.
systems: AFAS Profit through an authorised extract
Approved staffing agency rate and hours exports
An approved language-model service for explanation drafts
data_needed: Ledger costs by site, account and period
Cost-driver mappings and recurring commitments
Approved operational volume and capacity plans
Applicable CAO wage tables, allowances and employer-cost assumptions
Agency contracts, rates and planned flex hours
Approved treatment of one-off costs and investment spending
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted SharePoint budget register containing baseline reconciliations, formula and assumption versions, scenarios and approvals.

evidence.claim: Excel provides Scenario Manager, Data Tables and Goal Seek for comparing budget assumptions.
Versioned cost drivers and approved labour-rate tables can support deterministic budget calculations.
A 55% effort saving and two-times speedup are unmeasured estimates; negotiations may remain the main elapsed-time constraint.

risks: Incorrect CAO scope, allowances or effective dates materially understate labour costs.
Agency contract terms are treated as equivalent to employee wage rates.
Historical spending is copied forward despite changes in capacity or customer demand.
Sensitive employee or absence information is included where aggregated planning inputs would suffice under AVG/GDPR.
research_questions: Which cost lines have reliable drivers, and which need judgement rather than formula-based forecasting?
Who verifies CAO applicability, effective dates, allowances and agency charging rules?
How much budget effort is arithmetic and consolidation versus negotiation and assumption gathering?
Does a historical backtest improve budget accuracy without hiding site-specific constraints?

tasks.short: Review market prices and securities transactions if Noordhaven has investments or related treasury exposure.

today.trigger: If applicable: a treasury review, an investment transaction or a material market-price change.
steps: Confirm which holdings, transactions or treasury exposures need review.
Collect authorised transaction reports and relevant dated price or rate information.
Reconcile holdings and transactions to financial records.
Assess valuation changes, concentration, liquidity and policy limits.
Explain material movements and recommend any action for approval.
systems: Rabobank reports where the relevant information is available
drudgery: Re-entering transaction details
Checking dates and units across price lists
Preparing repeated market-movement summaries
today.time_sinks: Obtaining comparable prices and separating market movement from transaction effects. No securities portfolio or market-data source was specified.

lenses.faster: Reconcile transactions and calculate price movements from approved sources automatically. Re-keying reports and normalising units disappear.
lenses.autonomous: Receipt of an authorised transaction report or dated market-data update triggers reconciliation and limit checks. Stale or missing prices stop valuation output.
lenses.ambitious: If exposure is material, monitor liquidity, concentration and policy limits between scheduled treasury reviews.
lenses.joy: Remove repetitive price checking and table preparation. Keep judgement about treasury risk and whether action serves Noordhaven’s operating needs.
lenses.options: Compare holding cash, deposits and other policy-permitted instruments under interest-rate, liquidity and counterparty stress scenarios.
lenses.altitude: Set treasury policy, approved data sources and risk limits. Review exceptions rather than read every price list.
reach: Controller: treasury exposure and valuation monitoring
Accountant: transaction reconciliation and supporting valuation schedules
FP&A Analyst: sensitivity of cash income and funding costs to rate changes

tasks.human_edge: Judge acceptable treasury risk, verify unfamiliar instruments and approve investment or hedging decisions within company authority.
tasks.pattern_why: agent_with_gate: deterministic reconciliation and valuation checks prepare the assessment, with optional source-linked market summaries; people approve interpretations and any transaction.

in_practice.trigger: An authorised treasury statement, transaction report or approved market-data update.
steps: Verify the exposure scope, data permissions, timestamps, currencies and instrument identifiers.
Reconcile holdings and transactions to the approved ledger or treasury records.
Calculate movements and policy-limit checks using instrument-appropriate rules.
Prepare a source-linked exception and sensitivity report.
Obtain review before releasing recommendations or requesting any trade.
in_practice.human_gate: The director verifies material valuations and recommendations; authorised signatories approve trades or hedges. The workflow has no trade-execution authority.
systems: An approved market-data source to be confirmed
An approved language-model service for source-linked summaries
data_needed: Confirmed holdings, instruments and relevant treasury exposures
Transaction confirmations and reconciled balances
Approved prices or rates with timestamps and usage rights
Instrument valuation rules and currency conventions
Treasury policy, liquidity needs and counterparty limits
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted SharePoint treasury register containing source timestamps, reconciliations, valuation-rule versions, exceptions and approvals.

evidence.claim: Excel Power Query supports importing and transforming authorised structured files for transaction and price comparisons.
Reconciliation and limit monitoring are plausible deterministic workflows when instrument data and valuation rules are available.
The proposed 65% effort saving and 2.5-times speedup are conditional estimates; neither a portfolio nor this workload is established.

risks: The task may have little relevance if Noordhaven holds no securities or related treasury exposure.
Stale prices, wrong identifiers or currency errors produce misleading valuations.
Simple price calculations are applied to instruments requiring specialist valuation.
Generated market commentary is mistaken for a supported forecast or authorised investment recommendation.
research_questions: Does Noordhaven hold securities or other relevant treasury exposures, and what work does the director actually perform?
Are holdings, transaction reports and licensed price data available in a usable format?
Which instruments can be valued with simple rules, and which require external expertise?
Would faster review change a material decision, or is the current review already sufficient?

role.altitude: Become the owner of a trusted finance decision system: reconciled data, clear assumptions, effective controls and timely decisions about cash, capacity and investment.
reach: FP&A Analyst: routine consolidation, scenario generation and first-pass forecast commentary
Controller: recurring control exceptions, report consistency and cross-site financial monitoring
Credit and Collections Officer: portfolio-level exception review and cash-impact prioritisation
Accountant: reporting evidence assembly and financing schedules
HR Director and HR specialists: joint financial modelling of approved workforce and CAO assumptions
role.ceiling_note: The supplied tasks total 685.7 hours, about 42.9% of the implied 1,600-hour year. Current-workflow descriptions are assumptions to validate, and loan and securities work may be much smaller than the O*NET allocation. Savings overlap with analyst and controller work and cannot simply be added; negotiations, approvals, accountability and remaining role duties limit total capacity release. Time_saved_pct estimates director effort, while speedup estimates end-to-end elapsed time including automation and remaining human work. All estimates need pilots. At EUR 120/hour, released hours represent capacity value rather than an automatic cash saving.
skills_to_grow: Specify reconciliations, financial calculation rules and exception thresholds that software can test.
Build and challenge driver-based forecasts, scenarios and forecast-error measures.
Understand AFAS extraction, Power BI data lineage and access constraints.
Evaluate AI drafts against source evidence and identify unsupported causal explanations.
Design approval routes, segregation of duties and versioned reporting controls.
Apply AVG/GDPR data minimisation and recognise when workforce monitoring requires OR involvement or EU AI Act assessment.
Run bounded pilots measuring close days, forecast accuracy, DSO, invoices processed without touch and audit adjustments.
role.ambitious_version: Run a finance function where validated data produces draft reports and exceptions automatically, and the ten-person team spends more time resolving causes and improving decisions. Combine a shorter close with a regularly updated cash forecast, credible site scenarios and measured improvements across procure to pay, order to cash, record to report and plan to forecast. Expand into adjacent work only when it strengthens these outcomes and ownership remains clear.
